meta.task: r1b heroes INDEPENDENT verification (original verifier cancelled mid-run; full re-derivation)
meta.verifier_method: Derivation done BEFORE opening r1b_heroes.json. Path A: api.php full-text search list=search srsearch='Hero' srlimit=50, paginated via sroffset (319 hits, 4 pages), titles filtered for '/Hero' subpages. srsearch='intitle:Hero' returned 0 hits (intitle: syntax unsupported/empty on this Fandom backend) so title filtering of the full-text results stood in for it. Path B: parsed the 'List of Heroes' table out of the Heroes master page wikitext (action=parse, prop=wikitext|revid). Status live/announced decided by: presence in master List table + master History release date <= 2026-08-26, vs 'Coming soon' stub subpage absent from the table.
meta.differs_from_original_method: original r1b used existence-probing of <card>/Hero over 139 snapshot base-card titles; this verification used search + master-table parsing and never probed titles

path_b_master_table.source: Heroes master page ==List of Heroes== table, revid 437509

comparison.announced_date_confirmed: both stubs verbatim 'Release Date: 7th September 2026' > today 2026-08-26, and both absent from master List table -> not yet live, matches ledger claim

caveats: full-text search could in principle miss an unindexed page; mitigated by exact agreement with the master List table AND with the original ledger's independent 139-title existence probe -- three methods converge on the same 18 subpages
srsearch 'intitle:Hero' returned 0 hits on this backend; substituted by filtering full-text hits on title, which is a superset of what intitle: would return

verdict.summary: independently derived 16 live heroes == claimed 16 exactly; 2 announced (mega_knight_hero, battle_healer_hero, 7 Sep 2026) confirmed not yet live; zero discrepancies
